MonoBrowser Mobile 0.2.1

Page theme, separate from the browser theme
- Web pages no longer follow the browser's light/dark look: Settings -> Appearance -> Page theme (follow system, light, dark)
- Per site: menu -> More -> Page theme (default, light, dark); applies instantly, without reloading; manage the list in Settings
- "Darken sites without a dark theme" (on by default) darkens pages that have no dark design of their own
- Choices made in private tabs are never saved
- Replaces "Dark mode for websites" from 0.2.0; your previous choice is carried over

Also
- Text size moved out of the menu (still in Settings and the command palette, type "/text size")
- Fixed a possible crash on WebView versions that report but refuse page darkening

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.2.1.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. If Google Play Protect asks to scan the app, choose "Scan app". Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.2.1.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Updating from 0.2.0 keeps your tabs, bookmarks and settings; 0.2.0 also offers the update in the app.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.2.1.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.2.1.apk.sha256`)
